scope: Nationally available founder education and federal small-business guidance

records.name: Nasdaq Entrepreneurial Center Workbooks and Toolkits
records.description: Provides free founder workbooks, toolkits, virtual learning resources, and communities covering capital readiness, pitching, milestone planning, founder compensation, internships, retail and consumer-products growth, and other business-building needs.
records.availability_notes: Most resources are free, but individual toolkits may require a registration form. Program offerings, cohorts, communities, and access requirements can change. Verified August 4, 2026.

records.name: SBA National Resource Guide
records.description: Current national U.S. Small Business Administration guide to federal small-business counseling, capital, contracting, and SBA programs and operations.
records.availability_notes: The English national edition was last updated June 5, 2026. Program rules, contacts, eligibility, loan terms, and contracting requirements should be rechecked before recommendation.
